summary: What breaks or needs different handling when the Cockpit launches sessions and reads status events on Windows?

resolution.gist: Full findings documented in docs/research/windows-behavior.md: native vs WSL vs Git Bash installations affect how claude.exe vs claude.cmd can be spawned; PowerShell/cmd/Git Bash quote arguments differently; running claude as the terminal process avoids quoting issues; exec-form hooks with node and ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} paths work on Windows with Claude Code 2.1.139+; file watching needs careful implementation due to event coalescing; WSL behaves like Linux.
